entry.title: Aggregate read-only MMIS work-order details with one session and isolated failures
entry.description: For a fault notice with linked work orders, reuse one authenticated MMISSession across domain Readers, classify by the work-order number, cache repeated numbers, and keep each failed detail as an explicit error item while preserving the original notice JSON.
applicable_when: Adding detailed data from linked MMIS work orders to an existing read-only query
advantages: Avoids repeated login and duplicate work-order queries
Preserves source data even when one linked detail query fails
disadvantages: Sequential detail reads add latency when a notice links many work orders
recommended_when: Building read-only multi-order MMIS query aggregations
notes: Use the existing domain Reader.run methods and let each app switch through MaximoEventClient on the same MMISSession.
Classify MMISClientError network failures through the requests exception cause chain and known transport error shape; do not retry parse, authentication, or not-found failures.

The explicit whole-order retry budget is three attempts: immediate second attempt, one-second delay before the third. Existing transport GET retries are a separate layer; Maximo POST transport retries remain disabled.
The 2026-10-14 live read of fault notice 1150910-14 returned successful detail for two C-series orders and one 1A order with one shared session.
